# Areas reference

Every method of the areas resources and every object they return. Types link to their section; objects used by several areas are in [shared objects](shared.md).

## Structure

The objects each method returns, and the objects inside them. An object is expanded the first time it appears.

- `lookupPostcode()`: [`AreaHierarchy`](shared.md#areahierarchy)
  - `neighbourhood()`: `?`[`AreaReference`](shared.md#areareference)
  - `district()`: `?`[`AreaReference`](shared.md#areareference)
  - `municipality()`: `?`[`AreaReference`](shared.md#areareference)
  - `province()`: `?`[`AreaReference`](shared.md#areareference)
  - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)
    - `credits()`: `?`[`Credits`](shared.md#credits)
- `lookupCoordinates()`: [`AreaHierarchy`](shared.md#areahierarchy)
- `find()`: [`Area`](#area)
  - `parents()`: `list<`[`AreaParent`](#areaparent)`>`
  - `centroid()`: `?`[`Location`](shared.md#location)
  - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)
- `stats()`: [`AreaStatistics`](#areastatistics)
  - `area()`: [`AreaReference`](shared.md#areareference)
  - `market()`: [`MarketStatistics`](#marketstatistics)
  - `stock()`: `?`[`StockStatistics`](#stockstatistics)
  - `environment()`: `?`[`EnvironmentStatistics`](#environmentstatistics)
  - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)
- `trends()`: [`AreaTrends`](#areatrends)
  - `area()`: [`AreaReference`](shared.md#areareference)
  - `points()`: `list<`[`TrendPoint`](#trendpoint)`>`
  - `parents()`: `list<`[`TrendSeries`](#trendseries)`>|null`
    - `points()`: `list<`[`TrendPoint`](#trendpoint)`>`
  - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)
- `demographics()`: [`Demographics`](#demographics)
  - `area()`: [`AreaReference`](shared.md#areareference)
  - `households()`: `?`[`Households`](#households)
  - `age()`: `?`[`AgeShares`](#ageshares)
  - `meta()`: `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta)
- `find()`: [`Area`](#area)

## Methods

<a name="areas-methods"></a>
### `Areas`

| Method | Returns | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `withArea(AreaLocator $area)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the area of the locator. |
| `withNeighbourhood(string $code)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the neighbourhood with the CBS code. |
| `withDistrict(string $code)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the district with the CBS code. |
| `withMunicipality(string $code)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the municipality with the CBS code. |
| `withProvince(string $code)` | `static` | Returns a copy for the province with the code. |
| `withPostcode4(string $postcode)` | `PostcodeArea` | Returns a `PostcodeArea` for the four-digit postcode. |
| `withPostcode6(string $postcode)` | `PostcodeArea` | Returns a `PostcodeArea` for the six-character postcode. |
| `national()` | `static` | Returns a copy for the Netherlands. |
| `lookupPostcode(string $postcode)` | [`AreaHierarchy`](shared.md#areahierarchy) | Area lookup |
| `lookupCoordinates(string\|float $latitude, string\|float $longitude)` | [`AreaHierarchy`](shared.md#areahierarchy) | Area lookup |
| `find(bool $includeRd = false)` | [`Area`](#area) | Area |
| `stats()` | [`AreaStatistics`](#areastatistics) | Area statistics |
| `trends(TrendMetric\|string\|null $metric = null, ?DateTimeInterface $from = null, ?DateTimeInterface $to = null, bool $includeRd = false)` | [`AreaTrends`](#areatrends) | Price index |
| `demographics()` | [`Demographics`](#demographics) | Demographics |
| `withMaxCacheAge(int $seconds)` | `static` | Returns a copy that keeps answers at most this many seconds in the cache. |
| `withoutCache()` | `static` | Returns a copy that neither reads nor writes the cache. |

## Enums

<a name="trendmetric"></a>
### `TrendMetric`

Implements `Contracts\Enums\TrendMetric`. Every parameter that takes it also accepts the value as a string.

| Case | Value |
|------|-------|
| `TrendMetric::TransactionPricePerSquareMeter` | `transaction_price_per_m2` |
| `TrendMetric::AskingPricePerSquareMeter` | `asking_price_per_m2` |

### `Area`

| Method | Returns | API field | Description |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `type()` | `string` | `type` | The level of the area, such as neighbourhood or municipality. |
| `code()` | `string` | `code` | CBS code (BU…, WK…, GM…, PV…), the postcode, or 'NL'. |

| `name()` | `?string` | `name` | The name of the area. |
| `slug()` | `?string` | `slug` | The name of the area in the form used in URLs. |

| `centroid()` | `?`[`Location`](shared.md#location) | `centroid` | The centre of the area. |
| `cbsVintageYear()` | `?int` | `cbs_vintage_year` | The year of the CBS area division the code belongs to. |
| `geometry()` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | `geometry` | GeoJSON, with include=geometry. |
| `meta()` | `?`[`Meta`](shared.md#meta) | `meta` | The metadata of the answer. |
